/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json, copy
original=json.load(open('\\''input.json'\\''))
d=copy.deepcopy(original)
fixes={
'\\''g02'\\'':('\\''m6'\\'', \" We also read about Fenrock Signal'\\''s new rooftop garden.\", '\\''Fenrock Signal'\\''),
'\\''g06'\\'':('\\''m3'\\'', '\\'' We met at a public birdwatching walk hosted by Nuvora Prism.'\\'', '\\''Nuvora Prism'\\''),
'\\''g07'\\'':('\\''m4'\\'', \" We stopped to admire Arvenholt Systems'\\'' window display.\", '\\''Arvenholt Systems'\\''),
'\\''g10'\\'':('\\''m2'\\'', '\\'' También leí una noticia sobre una exposición en Solvren Taller.'\\'', '\\''Solvren Taller'\\''),
'\\''g12'\\'':('\\''m4'\\'', '\\'' I also read that Ashverin Media is sponsoring the party.'\\'', '\\''Ashverin Media'\\'')}
for story in d['\\''stories'\\'']:
    mid,extra,org=fixes[story['\\''id'\\'']]
    m=next(m for m in story['\\''memories'\\''] if m['\\''id'\\'']==mid)
    m['\\''text'\\'']+=extra
    m['\\''organizations'\\''].append({'\\''surface'\\'':org,'\\''org'\\'':org,'\\''relation'\\'':'\\''other'\\''})
    assert org in {t['\\''org'\\''] for t in story['\\''timeline'\\'']}
    assert m['\\''filler'\\''] and m['\\''jobs'\\'']==[]
    assert all(o['\\''surface'\\''] in m['\\''text'\\''] for o in m['\\''organizations'\\''])
    before=next(s for s in original['\\''stories'\\''] if s['\\''id'\\'']==story['\\''id'\\''])
    check=copy.deepcopy(story)
    cm=next(m for m in check['\\''memories'\\''] if m['\\''id'\\'']==mid)
    om=next(m for m in before['\\''memories'\\''] if m['\\''id'\\'']==mid)
    cm['\\''text'\\'']=om['\\''text'\\'']; cm['\\''organizations'\\'']=om['\\''organizations'\\'']
    assert check==before
print('\\''Validated: only text and organization annotations in the five flagged fillers change; all now name a timeline organization, with empty jobs lists.'\\'')
'"
